issues.explanation: The white text on the main gold call-to-action button lacks sufficient contrast against the amber fill, making the label difficult to read.
issues.location_in_image: Primary 'Get in Touch' button in the hero section
issues.suggested_fix: Change the button text color to a dark navy blue (#0A192F) or darken the gold background to achieve at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

issues.explanation: The light gray body copy beneath the main tagline has insufficient contrast against the clean white background.
issues.suggested_fix: Darken the paragraph text color to a slate or navy tone that meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 minimum ratio).

issues.explanation: The top navigation bar contains a prominent gold button identical in styling and text to the primary hero button, creating redundant competing focal points.
issues.location_in_image: 'Get in Touch' button in the header navigation
issues.suggested_fix: Style the header CTA as a secondary ghost button or text link so the main hero CTA stands out as the primary action.

issues.explanation: Dark text is overlaid directly on top of the dark blue wave graphic at the bottom left corner, rendering it unreadable.
issues.location_in_image: 'About section' text at the bottom left corner
issues.suggested_fix: Set the text color to white or move the text off the dark graphic to ensure clear readability.
